reviewType: Codex source/dependency triage, not independent exploitability certification
scope: all132 baseline high/critical matches plus8 fresh-DB high matches, deduplicated into35 advisory assessments; no suppression

CVE-2025-13151.applicationUseAssessment: Python pyasn1 is a different library. App does not directly call this C libtasn1 function; transitive native consumers not exhaustively audited.
CVE-2025-13151.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Malformed ASN.1 passed to affected libtasn1 expansion function.
CVE-2025-13151.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2025-69720.applicationUseAssessment: infocmp exists but server is headless and app never invokes it; client text does not become TERM or CLI input.
CVE-2025-69720.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Attacker-controlled terminfo/analysis input consumed by infocmp.
CVE-2025-69720.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2025-7458.applicationUseAssessment: SQLite3.40.1 is present; app runtime has no sqlite import or arbitrary SQL/database upload interface. Historical evaluation journal is excluded; in-memory feature probe only.
CVE-2025-7458.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Attacker SQL with many ORDER BY expressions; absence of current route is not a library fix.
CVE-2025-7458.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

bookworm.nodsa: Minor issue, not fixed in upstream 12 branch

CVE-2026-102010.applicationUseAssessment: Native Node/C-extension dependencies can use C++ runtime. No own application call to this exact container operation; native call graph not proven safe.
CVE-2026-102010.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Trigger vulnerable native heap-container erase_if; installed package match alone does not establish caller.
CVE-2026-102010.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-107778.applicationUseAssessment: No GSS acceptor service in app. Saved SQL uses restricted password/TLS; Kerberos libraries may be linked dependencies.
CVE-2026-107778.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Kerberos client data reaching GSS acceptor; client-library linkage is not an acceptor endpoint.
CVE-2026-107778.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-112314.applicationUseAssessment: App uses HTTP OAuth and PostgreSQL password/TLS, not a GSS-RPC client interface. Client-library linkage alone does not prove clnttcp_call is reached; native reachability remains unproven.
CVE-2026-112314.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Malicious/mismatched RPC replies or authentication retries reaching affected GSS-RPC client.
CVE-2026-112314.decision: fresh database disclosure, not a package update; retained unresolved; no compatible fixed Bookworm package

CVE-2026-112320.applicationUseAssessment: No kadmind/GSS-RPC server is started or exposed by the app. Retain the library source finding.
CVE-2026-112320.untrustedInputPrerequisites: RPC authentication flavor switching on a Kerberos admin TCP connection.
CVE-2026-112320.decision: fresh database disclosure, not a package update; retained unresolved; no compatible fixed Bookworm package

CVE-2026-112321.applicationUseAssessment: No kadmind/Kerberos RPC server is started; FastAPI JSON and PostgreSQL password/TLS are separate protocols.
CVE-2026-112321.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-112322.applicationUseAssessment: No kadmind or Kerberos admin client list in app runtime. Libraries remain installed.
CVE-2026-112322.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Many Kerberos admin RPC client entries and cleanup in kadmind.
CVE-2026-112322.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-112323.applicationUseAssessment: No kadmind endpoint; do not expose inherited library functions through new services.
CVE-2026-112323.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI init to Kerberos admin daemon.
CVE-2026-112323.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-11824.applicationUseAssessment: FTS5 is compiled in. App does not open attacker databases or expose MATCH queries; do not classify feature as disabled.
CVE-2026-11824.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Crafted FTS5 database/query consumed by SQLite.
CVE-2026-11824.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-119079.applicationUseAssessment: No KDC server started or ticket-input API. Outbound SQL client configuration is not a KDC.
CVE-2026-119079.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Crafted Kerberos AS/TGS request to KDC sequence decoder.
CVE-2026-119079.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-119373.applicationUseAssessment: FTS5 present, but no runtime SQL/database upload path. Untrusted activity text never becomes SQLite SQL.
CVE-2026-119373.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Attacker-populated detail=none FTS5 table and prefix MATCH query.
CVE-2026-119373.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-119374.applicationUseAssessment: FTS5 present; no app-owned SQLite file or user SQL/delete interface in runtime.
CVE-2026-119374.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Crafted database footer and secure-delete operation.
CVE-2026-119374.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-119379.applicationUseAssessment: ENABLE_SESSION is present; no changeset-apply endpoint or API in application.
CVE-2026-119379.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Crafted changeset passed to sqlite3changeset_apply; library remains vulnerable.
CVE-2026-119379.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-19499.applicationUseAssessment: No application strfmon call found; frontend uses JavaScript formatting. Upstream description starts at glibc2.38 but installed2.36 is marked open by Debian: version applicability remains disputed.
CVE-2026-19499.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Affected C monetary format/buffer path; cannot dismiss Debian open status by version range alone.
CVE-2026-19499.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-41992.applicationUseAssessment: App has no gzip CLI invocation or archive-upload/decompression pipeline. HTTP decompression is a different zlib path.
CVE-2026-41992.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Crafted files processed sequentially by gzip CLI mixed-format state.
CVE-2026-41992.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-53613.applicationUseAssessment: App does not invoke mount or accept fstab/filesystem uploads. Setuid mount helpers remain in base; observed no-new-privileges, dropped capabilities, non-root and no host binds mitigate prerequisites.
CVE-2026-53613.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Local helper execution, suitable fstab authorization and writable path; source bug remains unresolved.
CVE-2026-53613.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-53615.applicationUseAssessment: App does not probe disk images; no host devices or user disk-upload endpoint. libblkid package remains.
CVE-2026-53615.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Crafted block/partition image passed to libblkid and a consumer acting on false metadata.
CVE-2026-53615.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-5435.applicationUseAssessment: No application call to ns_printrr/ns_printrrf/fp_nquery. Ordinary DNS lookup does not establish use of these printers.
CVE-2026-5435.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Affected TSIG record printer must be called; transitive native reachability unproven.
CVE-2026-5435.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

bookworm.nodsa: Minor issue; libacl acl_*_file() follow symlinks; fix adds new acl_*_at() ABI, not individually backportable

CVE-2026-54369.applicationUseAssessment: App performs no ACL changes. Non-root/no-new-privileges/readonly-root limits privileged filesystem effects.
CVE-2026-54369.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Privileged ACL caller traversing an attacker-controlled pathname; not an HTTP activity-list input.
CVE-2026-54369.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

bookworm.nodsa: Minor issue; local TOCTOU in recursive setfacl/chacl; fix needs 2.4.0 acl_*_at() ABI + walk_tree rewrite, not individually backportable

CVE-2026-54370.applicationUseAssessment: No app ACL tooling call. Local path race requires additional execution/write/privilege capability.
CVE-2026-54370.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Privileged getfacl/setfacl/chacl or library operation on attacker-controlled ancestor.
CVE-2026-54370.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-5450.applicationUseAssessment: No application scanf/%mc call found. JSON/text reaches native runtimes, but the specific vulnerable conversion path is not established.
CVE-2026-5450.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Caller must invoke affected scanf format/width; no arbitrary C-format interface exposed.
CVE-2026-5450.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-5928.applicationUseAssessment: No application ungetwc interface; JSON encoding is UTF-8. Native runtime paths have not been exhaustively audited.
CVE-2026-5928.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Special overlapping single/multibyte encoding and wide-stream pushback; not proven reachable.
CVE-2026-5928.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-76844.applicationUseAssessment: HTTP compression/decompression can use zlib; no application gz* file-writing calls found. Deflate/inflate use does not prove this gz_write error path.
CVE-2026-76844.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Failed gzip stream write followed by affected subsequent gz* operation; native reachability uncertain.
CVE-2026-76844.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-78410.applicationUseAssessment: No app mount/fstab operation; helpers remain but tested privilege/device/host-mount boundaries restrict escalation.
CVE-2026-78410.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Local authorized bind source and mutable path plus ownership/mode mount options.
CVE-2026-78410.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-82560.applicationUseAssessment: No Perl POD rendering in app; Pod/Text.pm not found in inspected standard Perl directories. Package-source matching may overstate installed feature.
CVE-2026-82560.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Attacker POD supplied to affected Perl formatter; no app route found.
CVE-2026-82560.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-84243.applicationUseAssessment: HTTP inputs cannot set process environment or install locale catalogs; no host mounts or SSH service in app.
CVE-2026-84243.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Attacker-controlled LANGUAGE/locale plus writable malicious catalog; would require additional capability.
CVE-2026-84243.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval

CVE-2026-85091.applicationUseAssessment: Installed zlib1.2.13 is outside the description range1.3.1.2–1.3.2, but Debian marks it open. No own gzprintf/gzvprintf path; applicability remains unresolved.
CVE-2026-85091.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Affected nonblocking gzwrite stall and later formatted write; retain mismatch for expert adjudication.
CVE-2026-85091.decision: retained unresolved; no fixed compatible Bookworm package in current tracker; broader release change requires owner approval
